content.text:
I wrote the migrated file to `out/module.ts`. It type-checks under the project's tsconfig, and `npm run size -- out/module.ts` prints 251 bytes (min+gzip) with 123 bytes of my own code. I did not run the old and new code against test inputs. I also couldn't get a size for the original, because lodash isn't installed.

- **`doubled`:** `mapValues` now comes from `es-toolkit`, with the same callback.
- **`byNameKey`:** `keyBy` now comes from `es-toolkit`. It doesn't take the `'name'` string shorthand, so I pass `(row) => row.name`.
- **`toLookup`:** `es-toolkit` has no `fromPairs` outside `es-toolkit/compat`. I used `zipObject(pairs.map(p => p[0]), pairs.map(p => p[1]))` instead. When a name repeats, the last value wins, as it did with lodash's `fromPairs`.
- **Unchanged:** the exported `Row` and `Config` types and the function signatures are the same. No lodash import remains.

The original `src/module.ts` fails to type-check here because lodash and its types are missing.
